2. 🏋️ **Custom Home Workout Generator:** No-equipment aur dumbbell routines form tips ke saath.
3. 🥗 **Affordable Desi Nutrition:** Saste Pakistani high-protein khano ka hisaab.

5. 📝 **Workout Tracker:** SQLite database me daily progress aur weight record karein.

⚠️ **Pait Ki Charbi (Belly Fat) aur Weight Loss ka Scientific Tareeqa:**

1. **Spot Reduction Myth:** Crunches ya sit-ups lagane se sirf pait ki charbi pighal nahi sakti. Body overall fat burn karti hai.
2. **Calorie Deficit:** Wazan kam karne ka wahid qanoon Calorie Deficit hai. Apni maintenance calories (TDEE) se rozana 300-500 calories kam khayein.
3. **Cheeni aur Meetha Band:** Cold drinks, chai me extra cheeni, bakery items aur fried snacks band karein.
4. **Daily Steps:** Rozana 8,000 se 10,000 steps chalein aur hafte me 3 din bodyweight squats/pushups karein taake muscle loss na ho.

3. **Progressive Overload:** Har hafte ya toh reps barhayen ya weights increase karein taake muscle fibers challenge hon.

🧪 **Creatine Monohydrate & Supplements Facts:**

1. **Kya Creatine Mehfooz Hai?** Jee haan, Creatine duniya ka sabse zyada researched aur 100% safe fitness supplement hai agar aap rozana 3-4 liter paani peeyein.
2. **Sahi Dose:** Rozana **3 se 5 grams** kisi bhi waqt (paani ya juice me) lein. Loading phase (20g/day) bilkul zaroori nahi hai.
3. **Faida:** Yeh muscles me cellular energy (ATP) barhata hai jis se extra strength aur muscle fullness milti hai.
4. **Whey Protein:** Yeh koi artificial dawa nahi balkay doodh se nikla filtered protein powder hai. Agar khane se protein poora na ho toh istemal karein.

🧘 **Programmers, Desk Workers aur Students ke liye Daily Anti-Stiffness Routine:**

1. **45-Minute Rule:** Har 45 minute continuous baithne ke baad 2 minute kharay ho kar chalien aur stretch karein.
2. **Cat-Cow Stretch:** 1 minute ke liye reerh ki haddi (spine) ko flex aur extend karein taake stiffness khatam ho.
3. **Doorway Chest Stretch:** Darwazay ke frame me haath rakh kar aagay jhukein taake rounded computer shoulders khulein.
4. **Chin Tucks:** Forward head posture (tech neck) theek karne ke liye thori ko peechay kheenchein (15 reps).
5. **Floor Glute Bridges:** Kursi par baithne se soye hue hips (glutes) ko jagane ke liye 20 floor glute bridges lagayein.

🏠 **Ghar Par No-Equipment Solid Calisthenics Routine:**

1. **Chest & Triceps:** Standard Push-ups (3 sets x 12-15 reps). Agar beginners hain toh Knee push-ups karein.
2. **Legs & Quads:** Bodyweight Squats (3 sets x 20 reps) + Walking Lunges (12 reps per leg).
3. **Back:** Inverted door/towel rows ya door pull-up bar par pull-ups.
4. **Core & Abs:** Plank (3 sets x 45-60 seconds) + Mountain Climbers (30 seconds).
5. **Pro-Tip:** Har rep ko 3 second slow neeche le ja kar lagayein (eccentric control) taake bina wazan ke bhi muscle thak jaye.

⏳ **Intermittent Fasting (16/8 Protocol) ki Scientific Guide:**

1. **16 Ghantay Fasting + 8 Ghantay Eating Window:** E.g., Raat 8 baje khana band karein aur aglay din dopehar 12 baje pehla meal lein.
2. **Fasting Hours me Allowed:** Zero-calorie drinks: Sada paani, Black coffee (bina doodh/cheeni), ya Green tea.
3. **Fayde:** Insulin levels drop hote hain jis se fat burning teez hoti hai aur cellular autophagy trigger hoti hai.
4. **Ghalti:** Eating window me junk food aur pakoray na khayein, balanced high-protein food lein.
